checks.name: A1: every row's own leakage self-check passed, and every event kept an explicit clock
A2: project-family disjointness holds across every fold, and no test row's cutoff precedes its fold's training window
A3/A4: every feature's missing state carries value:null, and every observed state carries a real number -- never conflated
A5: every (family, outcome) report ablates its own family alone against the no-filing-evidence baseline, never combined with another family
A6: no feature family includes a displacement-index or DRI feature
A7: every report carries a signed GO or stop verdict, and no artifact combines families or outcomes into one score
A8 / dispatch directive: this run writes only its own receipt, and cites the exact outputs a later prediction card must reference
negative rule: no causal or product-score term appears anywhere in the emitted reports
negative rule: this run makes no product-score change to the existing prediction product
this card's own warehouse test suite stays green
